description: The letters the firm has received for one of the signed-in customer's companies at its registered office, newest first: title, sender and the date it arrived, and new: true for one that came since the customer last opened their Letterbox. You only see these details, never the letter itself; don't guess what it says. create_document_link with letter_id opens the scan on the website.

since.description: Only letters that arrived on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_letters
title: List a company's letters
